				SELECT date,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,

-- Query # 1 of 3 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 1 of 3 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined'

-- Query # 1 of 3 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date

			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs

		AND month = 06
		AND day = 05
		AND hour between 17 and 18
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-05 17:32:59'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "business_date_int", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), asset_class_clean as (
	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		asset_class_base
	where
		business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		/*and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD', '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) )
		and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) )*/
)
select * from asset_class_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_asset_class"

-- Description:
-- This query grabs data from ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging,
-- joins it to ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference data, and applies some
-- light business rules from the BRD related to deployment_disposition, 
-- probability_of_close, capital_usage_component, and transaction_cash_flow_type.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Initial version of query
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-05-12 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Edited source data columns based on business requirements.
-- v1.0.2 | 2025-05-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Added translation from True/False to Y/N for internal_transfer_y_n
-- v1.0.3 | 2025-05-29 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Remove the max timestamp logic and added run_id injection parameter
-- v1.0.4 | 2025-06-04 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Fixed probability_of_close which did not have the correct logic
--   because the BRD was using incorrect wording (opportunities/deals
--   in the data warehouse close, they don't exit)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SELECT
  --------------------------------------
  -- metadata
  --------------------------------------
  staging.source,
  staging.business_date,
  staging.run_id,
  staging.extract_timestamp,
  staging.extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
  staging.extract_timestamp_time_zone,
  --------------------------------------
  -- identifiers
  --------------------------------------
  staging.account_id,
  reference.scd_id,
  reference.security_identifier,
  reference.issuer_identifier,
  reference.cppib_security_id,
  reference.cppib_entity_id,
  staging.source_data_id,
  reference.sentry_security_id,
  reference.sentry_issuer_id,
  reference.model_portfolio_code,
  reference.deal_id,
  reference.upstream_pipeline_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other reference
  --------------------------------------
  reference.security_name,
  reference.strategy,
  reference.sub_strategy,
  reference.project_name,
  reference.investment_name,
  reference.country_of_exposure,
  reference.private_vs_public,
  reference.asset_category,
  reference.seniority,
  reference.risk_rating,
  reference.investment_department_id,
  reference.investment_status,
  reference.investment_lifecycle,
  reference.sector,
  reference.maturity_date AS maturity_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other staging
  --------------------------------------
  staging.funding_currency,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'
  END AS deployment_disposition,
  COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * (COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 0) / 100.0) AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
  staging.funded_amount,
  staging.quantity_net,
  staging.market_value,
  staging.portfolio_name,
  staging.sentry_security_type,
  staging.price_multiplier,
  staging.quantity_multiplier,
  staging.debt_factor,
  staging.model_portfolio_id,
  --------------------------------------
  -- fixed-values specified in BRD
  --------------------------------------
  CASE
    WHEN TRY_CAST(staging.expected_funding_date AS DATE)
       > TRY_CAST(staging.business_date         AS DATE)
    THEN COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 80)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS probability_of_close,
  'Binding' AS binding,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Net Income and Expenses'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n IS NOT NULL THEN 'Net Purchases and Sales'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS capital_usage_component,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Internal Transfer'
    WHEN reference.asset_category = 'Aggregate Projection Shell' THEN 'Aggregate Drawdown/Distribution Projection'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Income Only'
    ELSE 'Investment Funding/Distribution'
  END AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
  'Y' AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- 'expected'-related fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.expected_funding_date,
  staging.expected_trade_date,
  staging.expected_exit_price,
  staging.expected_exit_probability,
  staging.expected_exit_date,
  staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
  --------------------------------------
  -- will be calculated by python code
  --------------------------------------
  null AS unadjusted_exit_projection,
  --------------------------------------
  -- created by and updated by fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.last_updated_by,
  staging.last_updated_date,
  staging.created_by_user_group,
  staging.created_by,
  staging.date_updated,
  --------------------------------------
  -- source business dates
  --------------------------------------
  staging.business_date AS staging_src_business_date,
  reference.business_date AS reference_src_business_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- comment and error
  --------------------------------------
  staging.comment,
  staging.error,
  --------------------------------------
  -- null on purpose (from requirements)
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
  NULL AS fo_comments,
  NULL AS pec_recusals,
  NULL AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
  NULL AS fx_spot,
  NULL AS full_amt_cad_mm,
  NULL AS ticket_number,
  NULL AS rejected_deals_reason,
  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group
  -- staging.tfm_inv_sub_strategy
  --------------------------------------
  -- dw-specific fields
  --------------------------------------
  CASE 
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'True' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS internal_transfer_y_n,
  staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- helpful debug information
  --------------------------------------
  'ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging, ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference' AS data_sources_list
  --------------------------------------
FROM
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging staging
LEFT JOIN
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference reference
ON
  staging.security_identifier = reference.security_identifier
  AND reference.run_id = 'e7a187e9-eb2a-495b-b180-29a27f79083f'
WHERE
  staging.run_id = 'e7a187e9-eb2a-495b-b180-29a27f79083f'

radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_mean 
where business_date = '2025-06-04' and analytic_type = 'MEAN_10YR'
) as b on var.run_id = b.run_id and b.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name   
and b.node_name = var.node_name and b.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and b.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
and b.node_level = var.node_level

and c.node_level = var.node_level
left join
(
select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, node_name, node_level, sum(total) as cs01, run_id
from (
select *, reduce(cs01, 0 , (s, x) -> s + x, s -> s) AS total from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_cs01
where business_date = '2025-06-04' 
) group by benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, node_name, node_level, run_id
) as d on var.run_id = d.run_id and d.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and d.node_name = var.node_name and d.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and d.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
and d.node_level = var.node_level
left join
(

radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_dv01

case
	when mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id
	else mhl.parent_security_number

	when mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then 'CPPIBSEC_ID'
	else 'SECURITY_NO'

	when mhl.cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then mhl.cppib_sec_id
	else mhl.parent_security_number
end as ID_holdingDecomposition,
case
	when mhl.cppib_sec_id  not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then 'CPPIBSEC_ID' 
	else 'SECURITY_NO'
end as holdingDecompositionIDTypeCode, 
scdh.scd_holding_key_id as TBT_HOLDINGKEY,
NULL as INSTRUMENTGROUPCODE,
scdh.abor_instrument_type as INSTRUMENTGROUPNAME,
scdh.security_group_id as INSTRUMENTSUBGROUPCODE,
scdh.security_group_name as INSTRUMENTSUBGROUPNAME,
scdh.abor_security_type_id as INSTRUMENTTYPECODE,
scdh.abor_security_type_name as INSTRUMENTTYPENAME,

      when mhl.holding_level = 'Look Through' then round(mhl.total_market_value_qc/mhl.balance_nominal,6) 
      else null end)) as underlyingPrice,

scdh.quotation_currency_code as quotedCurrencyCode,
scdh.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as fxRateQuotedInCAD,
scdh.clean_value_portfolio_currency as marketValuePC,

0 as faceValue,

(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' or mhl.underlying_index_name in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then NULL 
		else mhl.underlying_index_name end) as referenceIndex,
upper(mhl.holding_level) as lookthroughLevelType,
abs(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' THEN 1
--           when mhl.holding_level = 'Look Through' and upper(trim(scdh.abor_security_type_id)) = 'FUT_BOND' and mhl.balance_nominal = 0 then 0 
           when mhl.holding_level = 'Look Through' and upper(trim(scdh.abor_security_type_id)) = 'FUT_BOND' then 1
           when mhl.holding_level = 'Look Through' and upper(trim(scdh.abor_security_type_id)) = 'FUT_EQT'  and leg_no = 1 and 
           (sum(case when leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_qc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id)) <> 0
           then
              mhl.total_market_value_qc/(sum(case when leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_qc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id)) 
           else null end)  as underlyingWeight,

         upper(trim(mhl.broker_code)) as brokerCode,

join holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl on  mhl.business_Date  = cast(scdh.business_Date as date) and scdh.scd_holding_key_id = mhl.parent_holding_key
left outer join reference.scd_securities scds on scdh.business_Date = scds.business_Date and mhl.cppib_sec_id =  scds.cppib_sec_id
left outer join asset.asset_futures af on af.business_date = cast(scdh.business_Date as date) and cast(af.cppib_sec_id as varchar) = mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id  
left outer join asset.asset_security_identifiers scds2 on mhl.business_Date  = scds2.business_Date and  mhl.cppib_sec_id =  cast(scds2.cppib_sec_id as varchar)

left outer join mdsprice on mhl.cppib_sec_id = cast(mdsprice.cppib_sec_id as varchar) and trim(upper(mdsprice.currency_code)) = trim(upper(scdh.quotation_currency_code))
--left outer join indxconstprice on mhl.cppib_sec_id = cast(indxconstprice.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
where scdh.business_Date = '2025-06-04' 
and portfolio_calculation_id = 'RISK METRICS_DAILY'
and portfolio_group_id = 'CPPIB GROUP'
and upper(trim(scdh.abor_security_type_id)) in (  'FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT') --, 'BONDFUT', 'FUT_IR', 'IDXEFUTURE')
--and COALESCE(upper(trim(Txn.broker_id)),'XXXX') <> 'INTFUT'
and COALESCE(upper(trim(mhl.broker_code)),'XXXX') <> 'INTFUT'
and /* exclude zero-balance holdings */
NOT
(
COALESCE(scdh.clean_value_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.balance_nominal_number,0) =0 and
COALESCE(scdh.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.next_dividend_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.balance_nominal_number_unsettled,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.next_coupon_quotation_currency,0) = 0 
)
order by scdh.scd_holding_key_id

(cast(smp.scd_model_portfolio_primary_key as varchar)  || (case
	when mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then 'CPPIBSEC_ID'

	when mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id
	else mhl.parent_security_number
end ) as ID_enterpriseHolding,

case
	when mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id
	else mhl.parent_security_number

case
	when mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then 'CPPIBSEC_ID'
	else 'SECURITY_NO'
end as instrumentIDType, 
case
	when mhl.cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then mhl.cppib_sec_id
	else mhl.parent_security_number
end as ID_holdingDecomposition,
case
	when mhl.cppib_sec_id  not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then 'CPPIBSEC_ID' 
	else 'SECURITY_NO'
end as holdingDecompositionIDTypeCode,

scdh.balance_nominal_number as quantity,

      when mhl.holding_level = 'Look Through' then round(mhl.total_market_value_qc/mhl.balance_nominal,6)

and /* exclude zero-balance holdings */

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

	select * from scd_perf

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD

			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly

				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency

			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'

 FROM (

			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs

		AND day = 05

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-05 08:36:58'
	GROUP BY

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

/* cppi::e2ffde6b64299756326f3f4a5df176afb448ccfb5067282b813fac59386366e8 */
SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency
							WHERE ((erc.vendor = 'wm' AND erc.currency != 'CLF')
							        OR (erc.vendor = 'tokyo' AND erc.currency = 'CLF'))
								AND erc.currency IN ('USD','EUR','JPY','CHF','AUD','CNY','HKD','NZD','SEK','KRW','SGD','NOK','MXN','INR','DKK','CLF','IDR','CLP','BRL','CAD','MYR','COP','GBP','ARS','RON','RUB','PHP','ILS','PLN','PEN','LTL','LVL','SIT','SAR','ZAR','QAR','CZK','TWD','THB','PKR','TRY','ISK','KWD','AED','JOD','NGN','EGP','HUF','MAD','PGK','MOP','VES','VEF','LKR','BGN','VND','BMD','XOF','BDT','ZMW','KES','HRK','MWK','GHS','MUR','JMD','RSD','TND','KZT','TTD','OMR','TZS','BWP','UGX','BHD','ZWL','IRR','ZWG')
								AND erc.data_date BETWEEN to_date('2009-05-24', 'yyyy-mm-dd')
								AND to_date('2025-06-05', 'yyyy-mm-dd')
								AND (erd.exchange_rate is not NULL OR erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag = 1)
						)
					)
			    )
        WHERE currencyToUsdRate is not NULL
        OR currencyToCadRate is not Null
        ORDER BY date

--Liquidity
select --'lcr_deriv_lt_17' src,
date_format(l.business_date, '%d/%m/%Y') "Business_Date"
,rmp.model_portfolio_id "MP_Code"
,pf.investmentstructurelevel1 Node_1_Name
,pf.investmentstructurelevel2 Node_2_Name
,pf.investmentstructurelevel3 Node_3_Name
,pf.investmentstructurelevel4 Node_4_Name
,pf.investmentstructurelevel5 Node_5_Name
,pf.investmentstructurelevel6 Node_6_Name
,pf.investmentstructurelevel7 Node_7_Name

,CASE WHEN l.parent_security_name LIKE 'CDS%' THEN 'CDS'
      WHEN l.parent_security_name LIKE 'CRDI%' THEN 'CDX' 
      WHEN l.parent_security_name LIKE 'SCDO%' THEN 'SCDO'
      else m.abor_security_type_name
 end AS "Parent_Security_Type_Name"
,l.parent_security_name as "Parent_Security_Name"
,brk.party_name as "Broker_Name"
,CASE WHEN p.party_name = 'INT_CPPIB' OR p.party_name LIKE 'Internal%' OR p.party_name LIKE 'INTERNAL%' OR p.party_name in ('INT. TRANSFER','Canada Pension Plan Investment Board','INTCLR')
        OR p.party_name LIKE 'INT-%' OR p.party_name LIKE 'INT CROSS%' OR p.party_name LIKE 'INT TRANSFER%' THEN 'Internal'
      else 'External' end as "Internal_External"
,date_format(date(substr(m.abor_maturity_date,1,11)),'%d/%m/%Y') AS "Maturity_Date"
,DATE_DIFF('day',l.business_date,date(substr(m.abor_maturity_date,1,11))) AS "Term_To_Maturity"
/*Leg no but need the logic to map*/ 
,CASE 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ','TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no <> 2 THEN 'Equity' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ','TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Financing' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'IRS IR' THEN
    case when esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap fixed leg' then 'Fixed' else 'Floating' end
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Credit' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Financing' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT','FXFORWARD','FXNDF')
AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Base' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT','FXFORWARD','FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Price'
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no <> 2 THEN 'Fixed Income'
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Financing' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no <> 2 THEN 'Future'
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Future Offset' 
ELSE NULL END AS Leg_Type

,CASE 
  --IRS
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap fixed leg' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap floating leg' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap floating leg' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Short'
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap fixed leg' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Short'
  /*
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Fixed' AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Fixed' AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Floating' AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Floating' AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
  */
  --Others
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long' 
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD',  'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD',  'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    ELSE NULL
END AS "Contract_Direction"

,CASE WHEN l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short' WHEN l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
      ELSE NULL END AS "Leg_Direction"
,l.underlying_index_name AS "Underlying_Index"

,case when m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' then concat(l.parent_security_number,'_1L0',cast(l.leg_no as varchar))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN concat('CPP',cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat('CPP',cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.holding_level = 'Look Through' THEN
               concat('CPP',coalesce(cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar),cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar)))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.holding_level != 'Look Through' THEN l.parent_security_number
      when m.abor_security_type_id='CDS' AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.cppib_sec_id != 'Not Applicable' THEN concat('CPP',l.cppib_sec_id)
      when m.abor_security_type_id='CDS' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(l.parent_security_number,'-999')
      WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.abor_security_number,'-999')
      WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.abor_security_number,'-999')
      when m.abor_security_type_name='Equity Future' then concat('CPP',cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))
      else coalesce(esmv.abor_security_number, concat('CPP',coalesce(cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar), cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))))
 end AS "Underlying_Security_No"

,case WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.esm_security_name,'-FutureOffset')
      else esmv.esm_security_name
 end AS "Underlying_Security_Name"

,case when m.abor_security_type_name in ('Bond Future','Equity Future') then p.party_name
      when m.abor_security_type_id in ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') then spi.party_name
      when m.abor_security_type_id in ('IRS IR') then spi.party_name
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') then coalesce(p.party_name, spi.party_name)
      else pc.epm_party_name end AS "Underlying_Issuer_Name"

,m.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS "FX_Rate"
,l.balance_nominal "Balance_Nominal"
,CASE WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN (
        'TRSEQ',
        'TRSEQIC',
        'CDS',
        'FXSPOT',
        'FXFORWARD',
        'FXNDF',
        'TRSFIIC',
        'FUT_BOND',
        'FUT_EQT',
        'FUT_IR',
        'IRS IR'
    )
     THEN l.total_market_value_pc 
     ELSE 0 END AS Leg_Exposure_PC 
,case when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQIC','TRSFIIC','IRS IR','FUT_IR','FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT')
        then coalesce(l.currency_of_exposure_code, l.parent_quoted_currency_code)
        else l.currency_of_exposure_code end AS "Currency_Of_Exposure"
,p.cppib_party_id ID_CPPIBPRTY_ISSR
,m.abor_security_type_name Parent_Security_Type_Name_SCD
,rs.abor_instrument_type_id Parent_Instrument_Type_Name
,coalesce(pgc.name, ' ') Underlying_GICS_Lev_2_Name
,coalesce(case when m.abor_security_type_name in (
     'Credit Default Swap'
     ) then
           date_format(date(und_esmv.esm_maturity_date),'%d/%m/%Y')
     when m.abor_security_type_name in ('Bond Future', 'TRS Fixed Income IC') AND l.leg_no <> 2 then
          date_format(date(esmv.esm_maturity_date),'%d/%m/%Y')
      else date_format(date(m.abor_maturity_date),'%d/%m/%Y') end,' ')  Und_Maturity_Date

from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough_extended l
left join holdings.scd_holdings_main m 
  on date(m.business_date)=l.business_date

left join reference.scd_securities rs

  and l.parent_cppib_sec_id = cast(esmvp.cppib_sec_id as varchar)

  and und_esmv.abor_security_number = undrs.abor_security_number
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pc

left join asset.asset_security_identifiers ai1

  and cast(ai1.cppib_sec_id as varchar)=l.cppib_sec_id
left join asset.asset_security_identifiers ai2
  on ai2.business_date=l.business_date
  and ai2.scd_id = l.Parent_Security_Name
left join party.party_gics_classifications pgc
  on pgc.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(pgc.cppib_party_id as varchar) = l.cppib_party_id
  and pgc.level=1

  and cast(p.cppib_party_id as varchar) = l.cppib_party_id
left join party.party pp

  and cast(pp.cppib_party_id as varchar) = esmvp.cppib_party_id
left join risk_prod.cppib_party_rating pr

  and l.cppib_party_id=cast(pr.cppib_party_id as varchar)
left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pf
  on date(pf.business_date)=l.business_date
  and pf.model_portfolio = l.id_model_portfolio
  and pf.InvestmentStructure = (select max(distinct InvestmentStructure)

left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc

  and l.country_of_exposure_code = rcc.country_code
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio rmp
  on date(rmp.business_date)=l.business_date
  and rmp.model_portfolio_id = l.id_model_portfolio
left join reference.scd_party_issuer brk
  on date(brk.business_date)=l.business_date
  and brk.party_id = l.broker_code
  and brk.broker = 'Yes'
left join reference.scd_party_issuer spi
  on date(spi.business_date)=l.business_date
  and spi.party_id = rs.abor_issuer_id

    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD',  'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'

    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD',  'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'

    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'

    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'

		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name

			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code

		from (
			select

				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country

				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month

				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from

				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case

					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1

					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code

				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time

			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name
), lt_clean as (
	select
		  business_date
		, id_model_portfolio
		, pool_name
		, security_name
		, total_market_value_pc
		, bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, parent_quoted_currency_code
		, parent_quoted_currency_name
		, currency_of_exposure_code
		, currency_of_exposure_name
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EU'
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end country_of_exposure_code
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EUROPEAN UNION'
			else country_of_exposure_name
		  end country_of_exposure_name
		, country_of_exposure_code as country_of_exposure_code_original
		, country_of_exposure_name as country_of_exposure_name_original
		, leg_no
		, parent_security_number
		, parent_security_name
		, parent_security_type_name
		, parent_instrument_type_id
		, investment_structure_level_01
		, investment_structure_level_02
	from
		lt_base
	where
		id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
), lt_lkp as (
	select
		  lt_clean.*
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'COUNTRY'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then 'QUOTED CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then 'CURRENCY'
			else 'COUNTRY'
		  end lkp_typ
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'CA'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then parent_quoted_currency_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then currency_of_exposure_code
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end lkp_value
	from 
		lt_clean

	select
		  lt_lkp.*
		, mapping.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mapping.external_reporting_region
		, regexp_replace( coalesce( mapping.external_reporting_country, mapping.lkp_nme ), '(\w)(\w*)', x -> upper(x[1]) || lower(x[2])) as external_reporting_country
	from
		lt_lkp
	left join
		mapping
			on lt_lkp.lkp_value = mapping.lkp_value
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_map.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'China', 'Hong Kong', 'Taiwan', 'Macao' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'India' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case
			when currency_of_exposure_code in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
	from
		lt_map

	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)

)
